unavailableProfiles.label: GAT562 Mesh Watch13
unavailableProfiles.reason: The watch routes a GAT562 bootloader LED output to its vibration motor and has onboard flash. It needs a watch-specific profile.

unavailableProfiles.label: Heltec Mesh Solar
unavailableProfiles.reason: Mesh Solar has different LED and peripheral pins from the supported Heltec boards. It needs its own profile.

unavailableProfiles.label: LilyGo T-Impulse Plus
unavailableProfiles.reason: T-Impulse Plus has different flash data pins and LED wiring from T-Echo Lite. It needs its own profile.

unavailableProfiles.label: LilyGo T-Echo Card
unavailableProfiles.reason: T-Echo Card has its own NFC configuration, buttons and LED hardware. It needs a Card-specific profile.

unavailableProfiles.label: Meshtiny
unavailableProfiles.reason: Meshtiny has its own factory bootloader identity and controls. A dedicated Meshtiny profile has not been qualified.

unavailableProfiles.label: MeshTracker X1
unavailableProfiles.reason: MeshTracker X1 has different flash wiring, power control and button polarity from Wio Tracker L1. It needs its own profile.

unavailableProfiles.label: Muzi Base
unavailableProfiles.reason: These four variants share Muzi Base hardware, which needs its own bootloader identity, LED polarity and flash configuration.

unavailableProfiles.label: Nano G2 Ultra
unavailableProfiles.reason: Nano G2 Ultra has its own flash and button wiring. It needs a dedicated profile.

unavailableProfiles.label: ThinkNode M4
unavailableProfiles.reason: ThinkNode M4 has different LED, button and power-control pins from the supported ThinkNodes. It needs its own profile.

unavailableProfiles.label: ThinkNode M8
unavailableProfiles.reason: A dedicated M8 bootloader is awaiting factory USB identification and hardware testing. No verified download is available.

unavailableProfiles.label: Seeed Wio WM1110
unavailableProfiles.reason: This firmware targets the Wio WM1110 Dev Kit (SDK carrier), whose LEDs and controls differ from Wio Tracker 1110 and XIAO. Its bootloader identity and installation route still need qualification.
